# National

This folder contains national-level geographic entities and specialized hospital departments relevant to the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB). It includes the national aggregate entity for Denmark, which serves as the primary benchmark for evaluating clinical quality indicators, mortality rates, and demographic data across the country's five regions. Additionally, it covers specialized intensive care departments that are central to technical discussions around clinical coding rules and the operationalization of quality goals for patient pre-optimization.

## Pages

- [[danmark|Danmark]] — The national aggregate benchmark for acute surgery quality indicators, tracking mortality, process compliance, and demographics across Denmark's five regions.
- [[ima|IMA]] — The Intensive Medical Department, significant in institutional coding discussions regarding the application of procedure codes for patient pre-optimization.
- [[ita-afsnit|ITA-afsnit]] — Intensive Care Units, central to technical alignment on quality indicators and the correct application of SOR procedure codes for acute surgical care.
